name: Offloop
notes: Offloop is a multiplayer workspace from Intelligence Software, Inc. where small teams run recurring business work — influencer sourcing and outreach, customer follow-up, research, launches, reporting — through named AI agents in persistent Channels with shared context, human approvals and OAuth-scoped connectors. It runs in a web workspace plus macOS and Windows desktop builds, with an iOS TestFlight beta. Requested via the form (issues #227, #306).
tagline: Scale your team’s work without scaling headcount

access.price: Private beta; Operator tier invite-only, Team Pilot and Enterprise priced "Custom"
